description: Five-layer reusable UI component catalog. Scaffolds (kind=scaffold) remain supported but empty for now.

kinds.component: Reusable UI packages selectable by layer. Available for both templates.
kinds.scaffold: Full-feature packages (routes, APIs, flows). Reserved; catalog empty for now.

layers.name: Foundation
layers.description: Colors, typography, spacing, icons, elevation, borders, radii, motion, grids, tokens.

layers.name: Basic Components
layers.description: Buttons, inputs, chips, avatars, badges, toggles, sliders, cards, tooltips, and other primitives.

layers.name: Composite Components
layers.description: Tables, forms, navigation, charts, calendars, editors, pickers, uploaders, dialogs.

layers.name: Advanced Components
layers.description: Kanban, Gantt, workflow builders, AI chat, dashboards, email composer, report builders.

layers.name: Templates & Layouts
layers.description: Page templates, auth UI flows, admin dashboards, CRM layouts, analytics pages, mobile screens, enterprise workflows.
